name: It Was That Summer
source:
It Was That Summer is a story-driven visual novel set in Cambridge, 2006. You play as Leon, a 17-year-old exchange student trying to make sense of a new city, new people, and who he wants to become.

It's a summer of small choices that add up: where to sit at lunch, what to say, when to tell the truth or hide behind more confident alter-ego.

There are no world-ending stakes here. Just the kind that stay with you.

This is not a story about saving the world.
It's about the summer you'll never forget.

[From [url=https://www.itwasthatsummer.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
《It Was That Summer》是一部故事驱动的视觉小说，背景设定于2006年的剑桥。你扮演Leon，一名17岁的交换生，试图了解新的城市、新的人以及他想成为的人。

这是一个充满小选择的夏天，这些选择加在一起：吃午餐时坐在哪里、说什么、何时说实话或隐藏在更自信的另一个自我背后。

这里没有世界末日的赌注。就是那种陪在你身边的。

这不是一个拯救世界的故事。
这是关于你永远不会忘记的夏天。

[来自[url=https://www.itwasthatsummer.com/]官网[/url]]
